{{Top|leg}}
An '''earshell''' was a personal item that allowed the nearly-deaf to hear better. During the [[invasion of Alanciar]], a continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], the native [[Alanciari]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] manufactured earshells to allow their hard-of-hearing citizens to better notice the warning sirens that alerted the population to attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].
